description: K.U.R. Wickremasinghe v. Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce & Consumer Affairs and Others K.U.R. Wickremasinghe v. Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce & Consumer Affairs and Others View More before Hon. S. Srikandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: K.U.R. Wickremasinghe v. Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce & Consumer Affairs and Others K.U.R. Wickremasinghe v. Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce & Consumer Affairs and Others View More
keywords: Petitioner sought to compel Respondents to pay the specified entitlements of balance salary upto date of retirement; Petitioner had expressly rejected new placement and chose to retire early. Held - no public duty on Respondents to grant benefits. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
